Entry.JapaneseText: 白熱する司会者
Entry.EnglishText: Passionate Announcer

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁあっ！ 今日もやって来た来た！ やって来た！
Entry.EnglishText: And here we are, with a new, new newcomer!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者がやって来た！ 不敵なその面構えはただ単に 緊張しているだけなのかっ！？
Entry.EnglishText: A new challenger approaches! They bear a dauntless countenance, but could it be that their face is simply paralyzed with fear!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Dio>！ やんちゃ盛りの１３歳……
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Dio>! He's a rough and wild 13-year-old...

Entry.JapaneseText: ってまだ子どもじゃないか……
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, so he's still just a kid...

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもだってなめてたら、 痛い目に遭うぜ
Entry.EnglishText: Underestimate me 'cause I'm a kid and you'll be in for a world of hurt.

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ！ その軽口、 どこまで通用するか、 見てみたいところ！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, then! I'd love to see how far his quick repartee can carry him!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Mel>！ まだまだ子どもっぽさが 抜けない１３歳の女の子！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Mel>! She's still a small child, a mere 13-year-old girl!

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな小さな体で、 本当にやれるのか？
Entry.EnglishText: You're really going to try this, with that tiny body of yours?

Entry.JapaneseText: がんばります！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll do my best!

Entry.JapaneseText: うーん！ いいっ！ 健気だ、可憐だ、 がんばってほしいところ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, good answer! Both noble and sweet! I hope you'll go far!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Rondoline>・Ｅ…… エッフェル……エッペン……
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Rondoline> E. Eiffel... Epipen...

Entry.JapaneseText: えーい！ とにかく 言いにくい名前の彼女だ！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, anyway, this lady with the extremely difficult name!

Entry.JapaneseText: あはは、その紹介の仕方、 なくない？
Entry.EnglishText: Ahaha. Well, that's about the introduction I expected.

Entry.JapaneseText: その天真爛漫な返しが 気に入った！ お色気パワーは どこまで通用するか！
Entry.EnglishText: And I love her candor! Let's see how far her charms can carry her!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Couleur>！ あれ？ これは……動物？
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Couleur>! Huh? Isn't this just an animal?

Entry.JapaneseText: 誰だ、こんなの入れたのは！ 責任者出てこーいっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Who let this thing in here!? Show yourself and take responsibility!

Entry.JapaneseText: クルール！！
Entry.EnglishText: Couleuru!

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、しかしっ！ 戦う気力は満々のようだ！ 私も参加を許可しよう！
Entry.EnglishText: Aaand yet! It seems this little creature has plenty of fighting spirit! I respect it, and I'll allow it!

Entry.JapaneseText: クルール！
Entry.EnglishText: Couleuru!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Cless>・アルベイン！ なんと、あの英雄、 時空戦士筆頭でもあります！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Cless> Albane! Incredibly, it's that great warrior, the leader of the Heroes of Time!

Entry.JapaneseText: この闘技場でも 大活躍を見せたことが あるのだそうです！
Entry.EnglishText: He's even accomplished a few feats in the very arena he stands in today!

Entry.JapaneseText: 久しぶりだなぁ、この感じ
Entry.EnglishText: I haven't felt like this for a while.

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、その時のようには いかないぞ！ どう出るか？ 英雄<Cless>！
Entry.EnglishText: But our arena isn't the same as last time! How will a hero handle it, <Cless>!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Mint>・アドネード。 ダオス戦役では法術師として 戦いをサポートしました
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Mint> Adenade. As a cleric, she played a supporting role in the battle against Dhaos.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今回はひとりで参戦！ 戦いは苦手という<Mint>さん、 意気込みはいかに！？
Entry.EnglishText: But now, she fights alone! I've heard you're not one for fighting, <Mint>, but how are you feeling today!?

Entry.JapaneseText: えっと…… が、がんばりたいと 思います
Entry.EnglishText: Umm... Well, I think I'd like to do my best, at the least.

Entry.JapaneseText: 初々しい！ 多くは 語りませんが、なぜか どこか初々しい！
Entry.EnglishText: Such purity! Such innocence! She's only spoken a few words, and yet she leaves such an impression!

Entry.JapaneseText: 期待できます！
Entry.EnglishText: We can expect a lot from you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Chester>・ バークライト！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Chester> Burklight!

Entry.JapaneseText: 活きはいいが、 いまひとつ、時空戦士内では ぱっとしません！
Entry.EnglishText: He's got vitality, but of the Heroes of Time, he leaves the weakest impression!

Entry.JapaneseText: ほっとけ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Drop it!

Entry.JapaneseText: いや！ だからこそ、 ここでそのできるところを 見せてほしいところ！
Entry.EnglishText: And yet, for that very reason, we'd love to see what you can do here today!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Arche>・クライン！ ブライトローズの魔女と しても有名な彼女！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Arche> Klein! She's also famous as a witch, Bright Rose!

Entry.JapaneseText: 既に２００歳を越える そうですが、 そうは見えません！
Entry.EnglishText: It seems she's already lived more than 200 years, but you'd never know it to look at her!

Entry.JapaneseText: でしょー♪ ビボーの秘訣聞きたい？？
Entry.EnglishText: Right~? Wanna hear my beauty tips?

Entry.JapaneseText: 聞きたくありません。 ハーフエルフなんだから、 当然！
Entry.EnglishText: I do not. After all, she's a half-elf, so it's to be expected!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は<Klarth>・Ｆ・ レスター！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, <Klarth> F. Lester!

Entry.JapaneseText: 偉大な研究者として、そして 変人として後世にずいぶん、 名前を残していらっしゃいます
Entry.EnglishText: He's left his name to posterity as both a great researcher, and a great lover!

Entry.JapaneseText: その戦いぶりはいかばかりか！？
Entry.EnglishText: But how is he in a fight!?

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、できるだけ、 やるとするか
Entry.EnglishText: Well, I'll do what I can.

Entry.JapaneseText: 余裕ある発言！ これぞ、大人の貫禄か！
Entry.EnglishText: Such an easy response! Is this the dignified presence of an adult!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者は藤林<Suzu>！ この闘技場には色々と 錯綜する想いがあるそうです！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger, Fujibayashi <Suzu>! It seems she has a great many feelings on this arena, and not all of them good!

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、そういう想いを 振り切っての今回の参戦です！
Entry.EnglishText: But today, she will replace those feelings with something new!

Entry.JapaneseText: いつまでも、 立ち止まっては…… いられませんから
Entry.EnglishText: After all...I cannot remain standing still, forever.

Entry.JapaneseText: 幼いながらに、 その果敢な瞳が印象的！ 個人的にはイチオシしたい！
Entry.EnglishText: Though she's young, that fire in her eyes is iconic! She's my personal top pick!

Entry.JapaneseText: ではでは！ 早速！ 始めましょう！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, then! Without further delay! Let us begin!

Entry.JapaneseText: 準備はいいか！ いいぞ！ ではいくぞ！ 覚悟せよ！ 刮目して敵を見よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Are you ready!? You must be! So let's go! Prepare yourself! Focus on the enemy before you!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、ゆけ！ 若人よ！ 散りゆきても、 私が骨を拾おう！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, go, young one! Even if your broken body should be scattered, I assure you I'll gather your bones!

Entry.JapaneseText: 期待の１回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: A hopeful Round One... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: イエース、イエース！ 肩慣らしには充分か？
Entry.EnglishText: Aaalriiiight! So, how are you feeling? Have you warmed up?

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: 怯むな戦士！ 人々が君を応援しているぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: But fear not, brave warrior! Every person here is cheering for you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 注目の２回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Pay attention to Round Two... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああっと！ 不運なのか、 見かけ倒しか！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh no! Just a stroke of bad luck, or were they all bark and no bite?

Entry.JapaneseText: もう一度、修行し直して 出直してこーい！
Entry.EnglishText: Train yourself a little more and come back for another challenge!

Entry.JapaneseText: よーしよし、 まだまだいけそうだな！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, it looks like they're still ready for more!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここで退いて後悔するな！ 果敢に戦え！
Entry.EnglishText: Don't run away and regret it! Stand strong and fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: 白熱の３回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: A passionate Round Three... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああっと！ 残念！ １回勝てたのはマグレか！？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh no! Too bad! Was their victory before just a fluke!?

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、チャンスはまだある！ 我が闘技場は君の挑戦を いつでも待っている！
Entry.EnglishText: But they still have a chance! You can always challenge our arena again!

Entry.JapaneseText: なかなかやるな！ だが、いつまでも 上手くいくと思うな！
Entry.EnglishText: You're pretty capable, huh! But don't think it'll go this smoothly ever time!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、この敵を どう攻略していくかな！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, how will you approach this opponent!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱狂の４回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: An enthusiastic Round Four... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: 油断大敵！ 慢心一秒、怪我一生！ 少しのミスが命取り！
Entry.EnglishText: Don't let your guard down! One moment of hubris leads to a lifetime of regret! A single mistake can be a mortal wound!

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、この敗北を糧に 明日も生きて前へ進め！
Entry.EnglishText: But, learn from this loss and you'll go far tomorrow!

Entry.JapaneseText: いい感じだ、 上がってキタ、キタっ！
Entry.EnglishText: The crowd is hungry for more!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ！ もっと熱く！ テンション上げて オレたちを楽しませてくれ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, burn brighter! As tensions rise, bring the joy of battle to our audience today!

Entry.JapaneseText: 興奮の５回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: A stimulating Round Five... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああぁっ！ 残念無念雨あられっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh...! Too bad! So sad! Rain on our parade!

Entry.JapaneseText: 悲しいかな、君はここで終わり！ サヨウナラー！
Entry.EnglishText: Lamentable, but that's the end for you! Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: パワフォー！ ワンダフォー！ ビューティフォー！
Entry.EnglishText: Powerful! Wonderful! Beautiful!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: こいつは手ごわい！ だが、もはや敵前逃亡は 許さない！
Entry.EnglishText: These ones are strong! But if you run now, you'll never live it down!

Entry.JapaneseText: 驚嘆の６回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: An admirable Round Six... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: まさかの敗北！ 我々の信頼は裏切られたか！
Entry.EnglishText: And a sudden defeat! All our hopes have been shattered!

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、次がある！ 明日への希望を胸にしかと 抱き、またこのステージへ！
Entry.EnglishText: However, there's always next time! Keep the hope for a brighter tomorrow alive, and set foot again on this very stage!

Entry.JapaneseText: オーケー！ もはやこれは ラベルが違う！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow, okay! Our challenger today is operating at whole new label!

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、だから それってレベルじゃ……
Entry.EnglishText: Uh, don't you mean "level"...?

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: 相手がどんなに強かろうと、 君ならもっと戦えるだろう！
Entry.EnglishText: However strong the enemy, you'll always stand and fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: ラッキーセブン！ 希望の７回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: Your lucky number!? A hopeful Round Seven! Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああっと、惜しいっ！ こんなところで敗北とは！ なんという不幸！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh no, the grief! The pain! To try so hard, and get so far, only to fall and lose it all!

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、この敗北をバネにして、 飛べ！ 輝かしき未来へ！ また会うその日まで！
Entry.EnglishText: But use this loss as a springboard, and leap to new heights! A bright future awaits you! Till we meet again!

Entry.JapaneseText: よくぞここまで来た！ オレもびっくりして、 声が出なーーーいっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: You've done well to make it this far! I'm so shocked, I can't even speak!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、次の敵は…… コイツだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Now, your next opponent is...this!

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝っても負けても、 泣いても笑っても ここでおしまい！
Entry.EnglishText: Win or lose, laugh or cry, this is the final battle!

Entry.JapaneseText: 決戦の８回戦…… ゴーーーーー、ファイトッ！！
Entry.EnglishText: The decisive Round Eight... Ready? Fight!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者の負けだ！ だが、恥じるな！ 泣くな！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger has been defeated! And yet, stand proud! Do not cry!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここまで残った 君の勇姿は美しい！ 次こそはぜひ無欠の勝利を！
Entry.EnglishText: Having made it this far, your courage is truly brilliant! Next time, you'll win for sure!

Entry.JapaneseText: やったぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: I did it!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……やっと終わった……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Is it finally over...

Entry.JapaneseText: よゆーよゆー♪
Entry.EnglishText: So easy~

Entry.JapaneseText: クルール！
Entry.EnglishText: Couleuru!

Entry.JapaneseText: よしっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright!

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとうございました
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you very much.

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなもんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: That was nothing!

Entry.JapaneseText: えっへへ、ぶいＶ
Entry.EnglishText: Ehehe!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなもんだな
Entry.EnglishText: Huh, so that's all.

Entry.JapaneseText: よい修行になりました
Entry.EnglishText: That was good training.

Entry.JapaneseText: 皆さん！ すばらしい戦いと 奮闘ぶりに盛大な拍手を！
Entry.EnglishText: Everyone! Give it up for the fierce competitor who stands in victory before you today!

Entry.JapaneseText: そして、その勇士の名を 心に刻んで帰ってください！
Entry.EnglishText: And carve the name of that great warrior into your very hearts!

Entry.JapaneseText: では！ またお会いしましょう！！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, then! Until we meet again!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者、敗北！ 会場中、青い溜息に 満ちています！
Entry.EnglishText: Our challenger has lost! Our entire arena is filled with one great, collective, sorrowful sigh!

Entry.JapaneseText: 挑戦者！ 悔しすぎて涙も出ないかっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Challenger! Are you too mortified to even cry!?

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Dio>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Dio>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Mel>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Mel>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Rondoline>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Rondoline>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Couleur>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Couleur>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Cless>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Cless>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Mint>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Mint>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Chester>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Chester>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Arche>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Arche>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Klarth>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Klarth>!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんと！ 優勝です！ <Suzu>、見事すぎる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wow! A total victory! Incredible, <Suzu>!
